name: M3 hex standoff, 20 mm
variant: M3 x 20 mm, female both ends
summary: Brass female-female pillar for lifting a board off a plate with M3 screws.
source: Hex standoffs are not a standard. 5.5 mm across flats is what Wurth and Harwin make for M3, but the cheap kits are often 5 mm, so check yours before designing a tight pocket round one. The 20 mm is the body only, threaded both ends.
